people.name: Ms. Shubhlakshmi Dani

people.bio_quote: Ms. Shubhlakshmi Dani is the spouse of Mr. Hasit Dani, former Non -Executive Director of the Company, sister-in-law of Mr. Malav Dani, Non-Executive Director of the Company and a member of the Promoter(s) Group of the Company.
